intro: Powers Swift nested tables effortlessly — this essential main cord connects the wall socket to the pre-wired module for uninterrupted functionality.

features.title: Robust Power Delivery
features.text: Purposefully created with a 16A main power cord, it ensures a steady and dependable energy flow — effortlessly powering up to four interconnected tables for seamless performance across dynamic work environments.

features.title: Intelligent Series Connectivity
features.text: Designed for scalability, the system maintains a refined aesthetic while delivering consistent power to every table connected in series.

features.title: Refined Leatherette Wire Riser
features.text: Encased in a leatherette sheath, the flexible riser elegantly conceals and supports the power cord — blending durability with sophisticated design to complement the Swift Nested tables.

features.title: Zippered Cable Management System
features.text: A discreet, integrated zipper ensures the wires remain neatly enclosed and tangle-free, enabling effortless table movement while preserving a polished, clutter-free appearance.

features.title: Designed for Modern Mobility
features.text: Thoughtfully engineered for today’s agile offices, it brings together power, precision, and elegance — ensuring effortless connectivity without compromising on form or function.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Wire Riser And Power Cord For Swift Nested Table
